title: Measurement dataset and analysis code for "Measurement-Driven Modeling of End-to-End Latency in an Indoor Private Standalone 5G Network"
endpoint_quality: Mean UDP trial one-way end-to-end latency

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Complete measurement location; all offered rates and repetitions linked. Locations share one network installation.

calibration_burden: No held-out location latency calibration. Six global offered-rate offsets and shared slope are fitted on development locations only.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.intended_target: Mean UDP trial one-way end-to-end latency
practical_relevance.prediction_time: Conditional reconstruction after a60-second run. Same-run achieved throughput is permitted; all latency-derived fields, NetPwr, loss, jitter, current location targets and future TCP calibration are forbidden. Not a prospective offered-load forecast.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.
Resolve each stated measurement/information restriction with source-bound evidence.
Demonstrate a nondegenerate task with grouping adequate for its explicitly claimed transfer; retain limited scope if the present data cannot do this.

practical_use_contract.decision_or_analysis: Estimate Mean UDP trial one-way end-to-end latency under the exact registered input budget
practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated
practical_use_contract.inputs_available_when: Conditional reconstruction after a60-second run. Same-run achieved throughput is permitted; all latency-derived fields, NetPwr, loss, jitter, current location targets and future TCP calibration are forbidden. Not a prospective offered-load forecast.
practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: No held-out location latency calibration. Six global offered-rate offsets and shared slope are fitted on development locations only.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
practical_use_contract.actionable_output: Mean UDP trial one-way end-to-end latency in ms
practical_use_contract.failure_boundary: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

default_numerical_evidence.lowest_error_interpretation: Retrospective description of all frozen alternatives, including attempts and possible aliases; not a new selection or independent baseline.

case_specific_next_evidence:
Preserve flexible and finite-rate lookup baselines under identical same-run input access.

Add fresh locations/installations and controlled offered-rate/interference experiments with synchronized packet-level latency/loss logs.

If prospective control is desired, freeze a new task without same-run achieved throughput; use tail quantiles and operational limits justified externally.
